svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 05/12 The Quarry (Uncommon)
svg.desc: An old limestone quarry, now a place to gather. The pale rock walls hold the afternoon sun. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
